text: Caldera Energy Co-op runs 5,000 solar installations, each streaming telemetry every few minutes -- and almost none of it gets used. Billing closes out monthly credits by hand in a spreadsheet. Field operations finds failures only when a member complains.
One root cause, two symptoms: a manual process with no automated validation, and inverters nobody is watching in real time.
The forcing event: member Harlan Voss's credit tripled to $211.60 from a typical $84 -- a duplicated week of data in the rollup workbook, caught only because he happened to call.
VP of Member Services Renata Vance, Billing's Priya Shah, and Field Operations' Desmond Okafor agree: this needs a real platform, not a bigger spreadsheet.
Next: turning this discovery into a specific, testable definition of exactly what a correct bill looks like.
